requirement.statement: The .NET package SHALL provide a backend-neutral Portable Datalog core that parses, validates, and normalizes a v1 Datalog profile without depending on Cozo or Om.

case.given: A Portable Datalog program containing a base rule, a recursive rule, and a query
case.when: The program is parsed and validated by Datalog.Core
case.then: The system SHALL produce a normalized IR with no Cozo-specific dependency

case.given: A rule whose head references a variable that is not bound in a positive body atom
case.when: The program is validated by Datalog.Core
case.then: The system SHALL return a structured diagnostic instead of producing executable IR

case.given: A malformed Portable Datalog source string
case.then: The diagnostic SHALL include severity, code, message, and source span when available

requirement.statement: The .NET package SHALL provide a Cozo backend compiler that converts Portable Datalog normalized IR to parameterized CozoScript without depending on Om.Core.

case.given: A validated recursive Portable Datalog query and a relation mapping for stored Cozo relations
case.then: The compiler SHALL return CozoScript rules plus a query entry rule equivalent to the Portable Datalog program

case.given: A Portable Datalog query containing parameter terms
case.then: The compiler SHALL preserve values as parameters rather than inlining untrusted user input into CozoScript

case.given: A valid Portable Datalog construct that the Cozo backend profile does not support
case.then: The compiler SHALL return a structured diagnostic and SHALL NOT emit partial executable CozoScript
